Included browser extensions

The following unmodified Chrome Web Store extension packages are included with X-TREME PLAY'S and installed in its WebView2 profile:

- AdBlock 6.52.0 — extension ID gighmmpiobklfepjocnamgkkbiglidom
  Source: https://gitlab.com/eyeo/browser-extensions-and-premium/extensions/extensions
- AdGuard AdBlocker 5.5.3.42 — extension ID bgnkhhnnamicmpeenaelnjfhikgbkllg
  Source: https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardBrowserExtension

Both projects are distributed under GNU General Public License version 3.0. The full license is included as GPL-3.0.txt. The AdBlock package also carries its original COPYING and third-party notices.

These extensions are distributed as unmodified packages. Their toolbar buttons and popup windows are not available in the embedded WebView2 browser UI; some extension settings and features may therefore be unavailable. Future X-TREME PLAY'S releases can update the bundled package versions.
